tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas 'gro don mkha' khyab ma bzhugs so//

spyan ras gzigs bsgom bzlas ni/ dang po skyabs sems/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ lha bskyed ni/ bdag sogs mkha' khyab sems can gyi// spyi gtsug pad dkar zla ba'i steng*// hrīḥlas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// dkar gsal 'od zer lnga ldan 'phro// mdzes 'dzum thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// phyag bzhi'i dang po thal sbyar mdzad// 'og gnyis shel phreng pad dkar bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ri dwags lpags pa'i stod g.yogs gsol// 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dri med zla bar rgyab brten pa// skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngo bor gyur// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol ba 'debs par bsam la/ jo bo skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes ci nus bsags/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// kun nas dang bas phyag 'tshal lo// me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas 'bul// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis bzhes su gsol// thog ma med nas da lta'i bar// mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga// sems ni nyon mongs dbang gyur pa'i// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems// so so skye bo la sogs pas// dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i// bsod nams la ni bdag yi rang*// sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang*// blo yi bye brag ji lta bar// chos skyong mthun mong theg pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// 'khor ba ji srid ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' thugs rje yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bying ba yi// sems can rnams la gzigs su gsol// bdag gis bsod nams ci bsags pa// thams cad byang chub rgyur gyur nas// ring por mi thogs 'gro ba yi// 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig

/ spro na/ dge slong pad+ma dkar po'i thugs dam spyan ras gzigs kyi gsol 'debs ni/ gsol ba 'debs so bla ma spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so yi dam spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so skyabs mgon spyan ras gzigs// gsol ba 'debs so byams mgon spyan ras gzigs// thugs rjes zungs shig rgyal ba thugs rje can// mtha' med 'khor bar grangs med 'khyams gyur cing*// bzod med sdug bsngal myong ba'i 'gro ba la// mgon po khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis so// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// zhe sdang dbang gis dmyal bar skyes gyur te// tsha grang sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// lha mchog khyed kyi drung du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// ser sna'i dbang gis yi dwags gnas su skyes// bkres skom sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// zhing mchog pa tā la ru skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// gti mug dbang gis dud 'gror skyes gyur te// glen lkugs sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// mgon po khyed kyi drung du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// 'dod chags dbang gis mi yi gnas su skyes// brel phongs sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// phrag dog dbang gis lha min gnas su skyes// 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// po tā la yi zhing du skye bar shog /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ thog med dus nas las ngan bsags pa'i mthus// nga rgyal dbang gis lha yis gnas su skyes// 'pho ltung sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can rnams// po tā la yi zhing du skye bar shog

/oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// spyan ras gzigs dang mdzad pa mtshungs pa yis// ma dag zhing gi 'gro rnams sgrol ba dang*// gsung mchog yig drug phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /'phags mchog khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// las 'bras lhur len dge ba'i las la brtson// 'gro ba'i don du chos dang ldan pa shog / ces dang*/ de ltar rtse gcig gsol btab pas// 'phags pa'i sku las 'od zer 'phros// ma dag las snang 'khrul shes sbyangs// phyi snod bde ba can gyi zhing*// nang bcud skye 'gro'i lus ngag sems// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku gsung thugs// snang grags rig stong dbyer med gyur// ces pa'i don bsgom bzhin du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci 'grub bzlas/ mthar 'khor gsum mi rtogs pa'i rang ngor mnyam par bzhag / bdag gzhan lus snang 'phags pa'i sku// sgra grags yi ge drug pa'i dbyangs// dran rtogs ye shes chen po'i klong*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas 'gro don mkha' khyab ma 'di grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gsung byin brlab can no// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / 'di ltar sgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// bdag dang bdag la 'brel thogs 'gro ba kun// mi gtsang lus 'di bor bar gyur ma thag /bde ba can du brdzus te skye bar shog /skye ma thag tu sa bcu rab bgrod nas// sprul pas phyogs bcur gzhan don byed par shog /
